F A N T A S Y
Fantasy Interactive, Inc. Privacy Policy
Fantasy Interactive, Inc. (“Fantasy”) is committed to safeguarding the personally identifiable information that you share with us online. Generally, you can browse our website,
https://www.fantasy.co/
(this “Site”), without sharing any personal information. However, should you submit a form, including, but not limited to a job application form, contact form, or any email messages to any fantasy.co email address (collectively, “Forms” and each, a “Form”), you will be required to voluntarily submit personal information. We may also collect information on how you use this Site, such as resources browsed, searched and downloaded; the frequency and duration of visits, and your source Internet Protocol (“IP”) address.
Please read the following statement to understand how we collect, use, maintain, and disclose your personal information.
When Personal Information is Required
As stated above, this Privacy Policy covers the use of this Site when you submit a Form.
What Information We Collect
Personally identifiable information
This is information that may be used to identify you as an individual, such as your e-mail address, name, address, or telephone number. We may collect this information when you submit a Form.
Non-personally identifiable information
This is information that does not by itself identify a specific individual. We may collect this information in a number of ways on this Site, including, but not limited to, how you use this Site, such as resources browsed, searched and downloaded, the frequency and duration of visits, and your source IP address.
Cookies
A cookie is a data file that certain Web sites write to your computer’s hard drive when you visit such sites. A cookie file can contain information, such as a user identification code, that the site uses to track the pages you have visited, but the only personal information a cookie can contain is information you supply yourself. A cookie can’t read data off your hard disk or read cookie files created by other sites. We may collect information from your web sessions by using cookies, to determine, for example, user traffic patterns, and the effectiveness of our navigational structure.
Most Web site browsers automatically accept cookies, but you can usually change your browser settings to display a warning before accepting a cookie, or to refuse all cookies. You don’t need to have cookies turned on to use/navigate through many parts of this Site, however, you may have to accept the receipt of cookies to access some Forms on this Site.
How We Use Your Information
If you choose to provide Fantasy with your personal information, where appropriate, Fantasy or its representative may use this information to contact you.
We may use the personal information collected during the use of this Site to personalize web content where applicable.
We may send you email when you submit a Form.
We may also use your information for user research.
We may also use the information to contact you when we have major functional changes to this Site.
We may periodically send email for administrative purposes.
We may disclose information about our users when we believe, in good faith, that the disclosure is required by law.
Sharing Your Information
In cases where we need to disclose web usage reports to non-Fantasy parties, your personal information will remain anonymous. We do not disclose, sell, exchange nor trade your personally identifiable information to any mailing lists.
Maintaining Your Information
We take information security issues seriously. Consequently, any personally identifiable information is stored and protected on servers with adequate security measures. We will cease all communication and use of personally identifiable information upon your request.
Links To Other Sites
This Site contains links to other Web sites. Please be aware that Fantasy is not responsible for the privacy practices of other sites. We encourage our users to be aware that when they leave this Site to read the privacy policies of each and every Web site that collects personally identifiable information.
This Privacy Policy applies solely to information collected by this Site.
Changes To This Statement
If there are changes or additions to the terms of this Privacy Policy, we will post those changes here prior to implementing the change, and as such, Fantasy encourages you to periodically review this Privacy Policy so you are informed about updates.
If there are material changes to this Privacy Policy, Fantasy will notify the users of such changes using the personally identifiable information collected on this Site.
If you are interested in learning more about Fantasy or are looking to request a quote, please contact us.

F A N T A S Y - Careers
This individual may sit anywhere in the U.S. or Canada.
Realize the Unimagined
Fantasy is a digital product and innovation company. We realize the unimagined for the world’s most ambitious organizations. Founded in 1999, our global reputation is based on our teams’ unique ability to think beyond the ordinary and launch ground-breaking products and services. We believe that our phenomenal team is the core reason for our success, our growth, and our thriving culture.
The Role
As the Head of New Business Development, we're looking for a rainmaker who will spearhead the creation of brand new business opportunities with prestigious brand partners, driving our growth strategy forward. This involves introducing new brand logos and integrating new teams within our existing clientele while ensuring these partnerships are the right match for our projects. 
Positioned as an integral part of the agency's leadership, you will collaborate closely with leaders across research, strategy, design, technology, and production. In this role, you will create and implement our new business development strategy. Your responsibilities include researching and identifying qualified prospects, fostering relationships with potential clients, and negotiating and finalizing new business contracts. Success in this role will be assessed based on maintaining a robust pipeline of suitable opportunities, achieving a high closing rate with different brands, and consistently meeting and exceeding revenue targets.
Responsibilities
Lead the agency's senior leadership team in driving growth and achieving growth targets by developing effective strategies, creating actionable plans, taking ownership of the company's business objectives, and addressing any challenges that may arise.
Achieve the company's defined targets for revenue and other essential performance indicators.
Create strategies and systematic procedures to generate high-value leads. 
Cultivate emerging opportunities with new brands and develop new relationships within existing client partners. Foster and nurture connections with influential stakeholders and decision-makers.
Generate new business opportunities from initial qualification through to submitting the proposal and deal closure. This includes identifying the strategy and managing the pitch team.
Regularly report on the sales pipeline and forecast future opportunities.
Continuously improve and develop processes and tools that can increase the effectiveness of our new business approach.
Collaborate closely with the marketing team to support business development efforts.
Requirements 
10+ years of demonstrated proficiency in new business development, including selling design services.
Expertise in creating and implementing effective strategies to generate new business.
Proven ability to successfully close deals and cultivate long-term client relationships.
An extensive network of contacts.
A results-driven professional with a consistent track record of exceeding expectations.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Strong negotiation skills.
Previous agency experience.
Travel will be required for this role (min 30%). 
Fantasy EOE
Fantasy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Since 1999, diversity has been vital to our success and ability to create products and services used and loved by millions of people all over the world. We are committed to continually fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace.
